reason: I already have a drawer of half-used bottles, and $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli. The lab report and the empty-box guarantee are nice, but I would want to see the report and some real reviews first, and a brand I have never heard of with 1,000 boxes doesn't have any yet.
objection: $29.99 a month for a brand with no reviews, when I can get magnesium for less and I never finish the bottles I buy anyway.
would_change_my_mind: A real batch report I can open and check, plus a few hundred honest verified reviews, at a price closer to $20 a month.
